__comment: A plaque with a plan FITTED and the building REGISTERED. GREEN is the only glow state that reaches this -- RED and AMBER both mean a plan is fitted but survey has not passed, and share plaque_plan.png's untrimmed texture instead. plaque_plan_sealed.png is trimmed square and carries a pressed wax seal, bottom-centre, that PlaqueRenderer.SEAL_CLEARANCE (gated on this exact glow value) keeps clear of the picture and the writing above it.
